fields.schemeName: Indira Amma Bhojanalya
fields.briefDescription: The primary objective of the scheme is to provide nutritious and affordable food to the poor and needy sections of society and to economically strengthen rural women's self-help groups (SHGs) by providing continuous income-generating employment through the operation of these canteens.

fields.schemeName: Freeship Staff Ward
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the education of students who are wards of university staff and are pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate, or PhD courses by providing 50% of tuition fee concessions.

fields.schemeName: Personal Accident Assistance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support and compensation to farmers, agricultural laborers, and Mandi laborers in Uttarakhand who suffer injury or death due to accidents while engaged in agricultural work or operating agricultural equipment.

fields.schemeName: Shilpi Gram Scheme (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to re-establish traditional artisan skills among SC/ST communities. It provides free training, infrastructure support, and marketing opportunities to artisans in selected artisan villages.

fields.schemeName: Mahila Samruddhi Yojana (GSKVN)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to female Safai Kamdars and their dependents to start small businesses. Through this scheme, loans for various self-employment ventures are provided to eligible female individuals.

fields.schemeName: Late Jaswantsinhji Thakor and Late Rasiklal Andhariya Classical Music Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Late Jaswantsinhji Thakor and Late Rasiklal Andhariya Classical Music Scholarship" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department aims to promote classical music education by providing annual scholarships to eligible Gurus and their disciples across Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: Small Business (GBCDC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance at a low interest rate to SEBC individuals for small business ventures.

fields.schemeName: Mahila Samruddhi (Gujarat Backward Caste Development Corporation)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to create self-employment for women from the backward classes. Through this scheme, low-interest rate loans are provided to female beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
fields.briefDescription: This initiative provides academic fees and maintenance allowances to support students from Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh pursuing higher education outside the Union Territories

fields.schemeName: Transportation Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide loans for the purchase of auto rickshaws and loading vehicles. Through this scheme, financial assistance for vehicle purchase is provided to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backwards classes.

fields.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of Fish Retail Markets including Ornamental Fish/Aquarium Markets - Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the construction of fish retail markets, including those for ornamental fish and aquariums. Through this scheme, financial assistance for project costs is provided to individual beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: Art Exhibition Assistance in the State
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Art Exhibition Assistance in the State" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote visual arts by supporting local artists through financial assistance.

fields.schemeName: PMMSY: Cycle with Ice Boxes-Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the cost of cycles with ice boxes for fisheries activities. Through this scheme, central assistance is provided for newly purchased cycles with ice boxes for the initial crop.

fields.schemeName: PMMSY: Construction of New Rearing ponds - Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to expand fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas. Through this scheme, financial assistance and subsidies are provided for the construction of new rearing ponds.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Three Wheeler with Ice Box Including E-rickshaws for Fish Vending - Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote hygienic and efficient fish transportation and retailing through mobile outlets. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible beneficiaries for purchasing e-rickshaws equipped with ice boxes for selling fish directly.

fields.schemeName: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the cost of polythene lining for new ponds in saline/alkaline areas. Through this scheme, polythene lining costs are provided to beneficiaries constructing new water bodies for fish/shrimp culture.

fields.schemeName: Khel Pratibha Puraskar
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Khel Pratibha Puraskar” by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to recognize and encourage sportspersons by providing cash prizes ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹5,00,00,000 to national and international medal winners across the state.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of Small RAS Culture System Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to boost inland fish production and create employment. It provides financial support for setting up Small RAS units for eligible beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Establishment of New Fresh Water Fin Fish Hatchery - Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Increase Seed Replacement Rate (SRR)
fields.briefDescription: The "Scheme to Increase Seed Replacement Rate (SRR)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to improve crop productivity through providing certified seeds at subsidized rates to all farmers across the state.

fields.schemeName: Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Promotion of Organic Farming under State Organic Policy" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote organic agriculture by providing financial assistance for certification, transportation, and organic inputs to farmers across the state.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Awarding Eklavya Award, Sardar Patel Award and Jaidipsinhji Awardj
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Scheme of awarding Eklavya Award, Sardar Patel Award and Jaidipsinhji Award" aims to encourage sporting excellence by providing financial awards to sportspersons for their achievements at the state, national, and international levels.

fields.schemeName: "Orthodox or Specialty Tea Production Subsidy" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Assam.

fields.schemeName: Gujarat Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Standard 1st to 10th
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for educational development to Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes 1 to 10. Through this scheme, scholarships are annual

fields.schemeName: Artist Honor (Gaurav Award)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and honor artists who have made a lifetime contribution in the field of fine arts, specifically in painting, sculpture, and graphic arts, and have achieved outstanding accomplishments.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Provide Stipend to the Persons With Disabilities of the State for Poultry Training
fields.briefDescription: The "Scheme to Provide Stipend to the Persons With Disabilities of the State for Poultry Training" aims to promote poultry rearing skills among persons with disabilities through a ₹2,000/- stipend for attending a 7-day training program conducted by the Intensive Poultry Development Unit.

fields.schemeName: "Subsidy for Orthodox & Speciality Tea Unit for Plant & Machinery" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme"
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Assam.

fields.schemeName: Scholarships and Stipends
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Scholarships and Stipends" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to encourage and support national-level athletes by providing scholarships to medal winners and stipends to participants.

fields.schemeName: State Mountaineering Reward Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides awards in the field of mountaineering is in place to enthusiastically engage and inspire the youth of the state towards risky and adventurous activities like summiting, mountaineering and rock climbing and to honour and commend the youth of the state.

fields.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme for Backward Classes Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide education loans to members of the Backwards Classes for pursuing professional and technical education. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of education loans is provided to eligible Backwards Class students.

fields.schemeName: New Swarnim Yojana (for women only) GNTDNT
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to achieve economic upliftment by providing self-employment with dignity. Through this scheme, loans for self-employment at an annual interest rate are provided to women beneficiaries of nomadic and denotified castes living below the poverty line.

fields.schemeName: Taluka Level Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Scheduled Caste
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Taluka Level Personality Development and Yogasan Training Camp for Scheduled Caste" aims to provide personality development and Yogasana training to Scheduled Caste youths through free residential training camps held at the taluka level across the state.

fields.schemeName: Free Medical Assistance (Gujarat)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for expensive medical treatments to Scheduled Tribe individuals. Through this scheme, monetary aid is provided to Scheduled Tribe individuals suffering from various diseases and for serious maternity cases and anaemia in women.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program”  aims to support mechanization in agriculture through financial aid for the purchase of mini tractors and power tillers to all eligible farmers across the state.

fields.schemeName: Tool Assistance Scheme for Pottery Artisans
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide essential tools like electric chalk and electric footmill to individual artisans with a 75% subsidy. It benefits pottery workers, particularly those of Prajapati/Kumbhar caste, by offering instrumental assistance and requiring a 25% beneficiary contribution.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Training of Scheduled Caste trainees Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase fish production and provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Caste (SC) people engaged in inland fisheries activities.

fields.schemeName: Sainik School Scholarship Located Outside the Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers financial assistance to students from Uttarakhand enrolled in classes 6 to 12 at Sainik Schools outside the state, with scholarships awarded based on family income.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nidan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free quality diagnostic facilities at all government health institutions in Gujarat. It benefits rural population by offering essential laboratory tests, X-ray, sonography services without charge at nearby government healthcare centers.

fields.schemeName: Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide immediate medical assistance and financial support to road traffic accident victims. It offers comprehensive medical treatment packages for various injury types with cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals.

fields.schemeName: National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm: Maintenance and Input Cost for Intercropping in Oilpalm
fields.briefDescription: The scheme component "Maintenance and Input Cost for Intercropping in Oilpalm" launched under the "National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm" scheme aims to increase the production of oil palm and reduce imports by providing financial assistance for maintenance and intercropping.

fields.schemeName: Vishesh Samman Pension Yojana for the State Agitators who became Disabled and Completely Bedridden during the Uttarakhand State Movement
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to honor state agitators who became permanently disabled and bedridden during the Uttarakhand Statehood Movement by providing them with monthly financial assistance of ₹20,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Loktantra Senani Samman Pension Scheme for Widowed Wife or Widower Husband of Democracy Fighters of the State Imprisoned under MISA/DIR during Emergency Period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension of ₹20,000/- to the widowed wife or widower husband of democracy fighters of the state who were imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977.

fields.schemeName: Residential- Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya/ Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free and accessible education for children from Class 6 to 12 by offering free education, accommodation, meals, study materials, sports facilities, and other essential services across all Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya / Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya in the state.

fields.schemeName: Yoga Wellness Center
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote holistic health and wellness among people of all age groups through yoga, naturopathy, and personalized counseling.

fields.schemeName: Oral Documentation of History of Tiatr
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to preserve the oral history of tiatr for future generations through documentation of veteran artistes' experiences. It provides video recording and remuneration to eligible veteran tiatr artistes.

fields.schemeName: SAKSHAM - KVK 2.0
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to equip beneficiaries with skills for employability and entrepreneurship at taluka/village level across Gujarat. It provides skill development training through Short-Term Training and Special Projects for diverse beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: Documentation of Tiatr through Research Work
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage research work in the field of Tiatr and facilitate writers to take up research work in different aspects of Tiatr, its Song & Music. Research work will be published in book form with remuneration provided to researchers.

fields.schemeName: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage research work in the field of Tiatr and facilitate writers to take up research work in different aspects of Tiatr, its Song & Music. Research work will be published in book form with remuneration provided to researchers.

fields.schemeName: Sakhi Niwas - Working Women's Hostel
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide hostel facilities for women with higher education or professional training, as well as working women, to stay in urban areas by paying a nominal fee.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: PM-Special Training of Geriatric Caregivers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to train and create a professional cadre of geriatric caregivers to meet the increasing demand for specialized care for senior citizens. It offers skill development and certification in geriatric care job roles to Indian citizens, ensuring professional services for the elderly.
